description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order made to amend the Schedule to the Order published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 281/7 of 24.01.1984 which specifies the Faculties and the Departments of the University of Ruhuna by adding the item '15. Department of Anaesthesiology'.
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It contains an order issued under Section 27(1) of the Act that modifies the schedule specifying faculties and departments of the University of Ruhuna. While it mentions a minister's name (Lakshman Kiriella), this is incidental to the legal/regulatory function of the document, which is to formally amend the university's departmental structure through statutory authority. The content focuses on regulatory changes rather than government personnel matters or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
